name: toolkit
description: Databases, SSH, HTTP requests and reusable Playbooks, with Copilot integration. All in VS Code.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run validate && npm run build:production
scripts.compile: npm run validate && VITE_BUILD_TARGET=extension vite build --mode development && VITE_BUILD_TARGET=webview vite build --mode development
scripts.build:production: VITE_BUILD_TARGET=extension vite build --mode production && VITE_BUILD_TARGET=webview vite build --mode production
scripts.check-types: npm run check-types:host && npm run check-types:webview
scripts.validate: npm run check-types && npm run lint

languageModelTools.name: assetsSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search saved Toolkit assets by keyword. Types: 'ssh' (sshExecute, sftpTransfer), 'mysql' and 'postgresql' (sqlExecute), 'httpClient' (httpClientExecute). Returns id, type, name, description, folder and connection metadata. Secrets are never returned.

keyword.description: Keyword to match against asset names, descriptions, IDs, types, folders, hosts, ports, database names, and base URLs.

languageModelTools.name: httpClientExecute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send an HTTP request using a saved httpClient asset's base URL, default headers and authentication. Returns response status, headers, body and timing. Redirects are rejected.

id.description: HTTP client asset ID or unique ID prefix.

path.description: Relative path appended to the base URL directory, or a root-relative path. Must resolve to the same origin.

headers.description: Additional headers, overriding defaults. Configured authentication takes precedence.

body.description: Request body. Set Content-Type explicitly when sending JSON.

languageModelTools.name: sshExecute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a command on an SSH asset by its ID. Requires user confirmation.

id.description: SSH asset ID or unique ID prefix.

languageModelTools.name: sftpTransfer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Upload or download a file through an SSH asset by its ID. Requires user confirmation.

id.description: SSH asset ID or unique ID prefix.

languageModelTools.name: sqlExecute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute one SQL statement against a MySQL or PostgreSQL database asset by its ID.

id.description: Database asset ID or unique ID prefix.

database.description: Optional database name; defaults to the asset's configured database.

languageModelTools.name: playbookSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search saved playbooks by keyword matching name, description, ID, or folder. Returns IDs, descriptions, folders, storage scopes, step counts, and step types. Use an empty keyword to list all playbooks.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive keyword, or empty to list all playbooks.

languageModelTools.name: playbookRun
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a saved playbook by ID and wait for completion. Returns success, message, and output. Steps run in order and stop at the first failure. SSH assets must allow AI access.

id.description: Playbook ID or unique ID prefix.

languageModelTools.name: playbookUpsert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a saved playbook from ordered steps, or update an existing one when id is given. Steps run in order and stop at the first failure. Local command cwd and command, and sftp localPath, support placeholders: ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolderBasename}, ${userHome}, ${pathSeparator}, ${env:NAME}. Returns the playbook ID and whether it was created or updated.

id.description: Existing playbook ID or unique ID prefix to update. Omit to create a new playbook.

storageScope.description: Storage location. Omit to use global for new playbooks or preserve the existing location when updating. Specifying a different location moves the playbook. Workspace storage requires an open workspace folder.

description.description: Playbook description. Omit to preserve the existing description; use an empty string to clear it.

environment.description: Variable definitions for the playbook run form. Omit to preserve existing variables; use [] to clear them. Provided arrays replace all variables. Commands and paths reference values with ${env:NAME}.

defaultValue.description: Boolean for checkbox; string for input or select. Select defaults must match an option value.

options.description: Required for select variables. Values must be unique and non-empty; labels must be non-empty.

command.description: Shell command for local-command and ssh-command steps. local-command steps support placeholders such as ${workspaceFolder}.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for local-command steps. Supports placeholders such as ${workspaceFolder}. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

assetId.description: SSH asset ID or unique ID prefix for ssh-command and sftp steps.

localPath.description: Local file path for sftp steps. Supports placeholders such as ${workspaceFolder}.

remotePath.description: Remote file path for sftp steps.

toolkit.perftips.enabled.markdownDescription: Show debug interval annotations while debugging. Changes apply to new debug sessions.

toolkit.storagePath.markdownDescription: Toolkit data directory. Supports `~`. Defaults to extension global storage.
